Luck
(Enchantment/Charm)

Level: 2
Range: 15 ft.
Duration: 15 rounds
Casting Time: 2
Area of Effect: 1 creature
Saving Throw: None

The recipient of this spell gains extraordinary luck for the next 15 rounds, receiving a +1 bonus to <PRO_HISHER> Saving Throws, attack rolls, and minimum damage/healing rolls as well as +5% to all thieving skills. Furthermore, damage dice for all effects outside a weapon's base damage is reduced by 1. For example, a 6d6 fireball will do 6d5 damage, and a flaming long sword that deals 1d8+2 slashing plus 1d3 fire damage will deal 1d8+2 slashing plus 1d2 fire damage instead.

Typed spell effects: save vs. spell +1 (Luck); save vs. breath +1 (Luck); save vs. polymorph +1 (Luck); save vs. wands +1 (Luck); save vs. death +1 (Luck); Luck +1 (Luck); Values may depend on caster level and target.
